svg.aria-label: Norwegian Atlantic Slope Current: two approximately 50 km static mean-core spans, with different vertical support. Proposed branch only; no seasonal range.

g.text: Norwegian Atlantic Slope Current · mean-core spans
1993–2022 mean fields · proposed identity · separate section supports
Four CTD casts; variable core reaches about 460 m maximum depth.
Variable-depth shape, 50 m top to about 530 m deepest point; no fixed width plane.
50% of mean AW transport; salinity ≥ 35.16 g/kg; section-specific isobath limits.
Static mean-core geometry, not mean widths, annual extrema or seasonal samples.
No paired geographic edges, uncertainty, whole-current width or area inferred.
Baumann et al. (2026), §2.1.2, Fig.3 · CC BY4.0 · independent OSW scalar diagram
